sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

content.text: Generate an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles.

content.thinking:
**Designing Anteater Animation**

I'm currently focusing on structuring the animated SVG. My plan is to create a clean, rich, and well-organized file using SMIL for animation, specifically incorporating `<animate>` tags. I'm also preparing to save this as `anteater-unicycle.svg` in the current directory.

**Detailing Animation Elements**

I'm now planning the specific SVG structure, using SMIL `<animate>` tags, including `<animateTransform>` and `<animateMotion>`, to ensure it's a standalone, browser-compatible animation. The composition will feature a circus stage background and a detailed unicycle with rotating components and pedaling action, all within a `600x500` viewBox. The anteater will be realistically rendered with fur details and a dynamic pose, balancing on the unicycle with a swaying tail and animated arms.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 500" width="600" height="500">
  <defs>
    <!-- Background gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="bgGrad" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="65%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff8e7" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f3dfc1" />
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Bottle gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="greenBottle" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2e8b57" />
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#48c774" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1e5c3a" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="amberBottle" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b85d19" />
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#f59f3d" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8a410b" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="blueBottle" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#20639b" />
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#4ea8de" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#144066" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Reusable bottle shape centered at (0,0) -->
    <g id="bottleShape">
      <!-- Body -->
      <path d="M -9,20 L -9,-2 C -9,-8 -4,-11 -4,-16 L -4,-26 L 4,-26 L 4,-16 C 4,-11 9,-8 9,-2 L 9,20 C 9,23 6,25 0,25 C -6,25 -9,23 -9,20 Z" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1.5" />
      <!-- Cork / Cap -->
      <rect x="-4.5" y="-30" width="9" height="5" rx="1.5" fill="#d4a373" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1.2" />
      <!-- Label -->
      <rect x="-7.5" y="1" width="15" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#fffdf7" opacity="0.9" />
      <line x1="-4.5" y1="5" x2="4.5" y2="5" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.2" />
      <line x1="-4.5" y1="9" x2="2.5" y2="9" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.2" />
      <!-- Glass highlight -->
      <path d="M -5.5,18 L -5.5,-1 C -5.5,-5 -2.5,-8 -2.5,-13" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55" />
    </g>

    <!-- Juggling arc path -->
    <path id="jugglePath" d="M 335,205 C 335,65 445,65 445,205 C 445,230 415,235 390,215 C 365,235 335,230 335,205 Z" />
  </defs>

  <!-- Stage Background -->
  <rect width="600" height="500" fill="url(#bgGrad)" />

  <!-- Ground -->
  <line x1="60" y1="428" x2="540" y2="428" stroke="#c9b18c" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Ground Shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="428" rx="70" ry="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12">
    <animate attributeName="rx" values="70;62;70" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </ellipse>

  <!-- Unicycle & Anteater Group (gentle balance bob) -->
  <g id="performer">
    <animateTransform
      attributeName="transform"
      type="translate"
      values="0,0; 0,-4; 0,0; 0,-3; 0,0"
      dur="1.2s"
      repeatCount="indefinite" />

    <!-- Unicycle Wheel -->
    <g id="wheel" transform="translate(300, 360)">
      <!-- Rotating Spokes -->
      <g>
        <animateTransform
          attributeName="transform"
          type="rotate"
          from="0"
          to="360"
          dur="1.2s"
          repeatCount="indefinite" />
        <line x1="0" y1="-58" x2="0" y2="58" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2" />
        <line x1="-58" y1="0" x2="58" y2="0" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2" />
        <line x1="-41" y1="-41" x2="41" y2="41" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2" />
        <line x1="-41" y1="41" x2="41" y2="-41" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2" />
        <!-- Crank & Pedals -->
        <line x1="-22" y1="0" x2="22" y2="0" stroke="#555" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />
        <rect x="-28" y="-4" width="12" height="7" rx="2" fill="#333" />
        <rect x="16" y="-4" width="12" height="7" rx="2" fill="#333" />
      </g>
      <!-- Tire & Rim -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="62" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="10" />
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="56" fill="none" stroke="#d0d0d0" stroke-width="3" />
      <!-- Hub -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="#555" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2" />
    </g>

    <!-- Unicycle Fork & Seat Post -->
    <path d="M 300,360 L 300,295 L 300,265" fill="none" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <circle cx="300" cy="360" r="5" fill="#c0392b" />
    <!-- Saddle -->
    <path d="M 278,265 Q 300,256 322,265 Q 318,274 300,273 Q 282,274 278,265 Z" fill="#3d2b1f" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- Anteater Back Leg (pedaling) -->
    <path d="M 292,258 Q 275,305 282,350" fill="none" stroke="#5c4e46" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round">
      <animate attributeName="d"
        values="M 292,258 Q 275,305 282,350; M 292,258 Q 285,310 318,362; M 292,258 Q 275,305 282,350"
        dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </path>

    <!-- Anteater Bushy Tail -->
    <path d="M 275,245 C 230,245 190,285 165,260 C 150,245 165,215 195,220 C 225,225 250,232 275,232 Z" fill="#4a3f39" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2">
      <animateTransform
        attributeName="transform"
        type="rotate"
        values="-3 275 240; 4 275 240; -3 275 240"
        dur="1.6s"
        repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </path>

    <!-- Anteater Torso -->
    <path d="M 272,255 C 268,215 280,170 308,162 C 330,156 340,178 334,215 C 328,248 310,262 290,262 Z" fill="#6d5d53" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Classic Giant Anteater Black & White Shoulder Stripe -->
    <path d="M 276,228 C 288,205 305,182 325,174 L 331,188 C 312,196 296,216 284,240 Z" fill="#1e1e1e" />
    <path d="M 275,223 C 287,200 304,177 323,169" fill="none" stroke="#f2ede4" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" />

    <!-- Anteater Front Leg (pedaling) -->
    <path d="M 304,258 Q 325,305 318,362" fill="none" stroke="#6d5d53" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round">
      <animate attributeName="d"
        values="M 304,258 Q 325,305 318,362; M 304,258 Q 290,305 282,350; M 304,258 Q 325,305 318,362"
        dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </path>

    <!-- Anteater Head & Long Snout -->
    <g id="head">
      <animateTransform
        attributeName="transform"
        type="rotate"
        values="-2 315 168; 2 315 168; -2 315 168"
        dur="1.2s"
        repeatCount="indefinite" />
      <!-- Ear -->
      <ellipse cx="305" cy="148" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#5c4e46" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1.8" />
      <!-- Head & Snout -->
      <path d="M 302,168 C 302,148 320,144 334,150 C 355,158 386,170 404,178 C 409,180 408,187 402,188 C 380,188 352,182 326,182 C 312,182 302,178 302,168 Z" fill="#6d5d53" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2" />
      <!-- Nose tip -->
      <circle cx="405" cy="183" r="3.5" fill="#1e1e1e" />
      <!-- Eye -->
      <circle cx="326" cy="159" r="3" fill="#111" />
      <circle cx="327" cy="158" r="1" fill="#fff" />
    </g>

    <!-- Anteater Juggling Arms -->
    <!-- Left Arm -->
    <path d="M 310,190 Q 322,212 336,205" fill="none" stroke="#5c4e46" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round">
      <animate attributeName="d"
        values="M 310,190 Q 322,212 336,205; M 310,190 Q 324,204 338,196; M 310,190 Q 322,212 336,205"
        dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </path>
    <!-- Right Arm -->
    <path d="M 326,192 Q 380,215 442,205" fill="none" stroke="#6d5d53" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round">
      <animate attributeName="d"
        values="M 326,192 Q 380,215 442,205; M 326,192 Q 380,222 444,212; M 326,192 Q 380,215 442,205"
        dur="0.8s" begin="-0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </path>
  </g>

  <!-- Juggling Bottles -->
  <!-- Bottle 1: Green -->
  <g>
    <animateMotion dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0s">
      <mpath href="#jugglePath" />
    </animateMotion>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      <use href="#bottleShape" fill="url(#greenBottle)" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottle 2: Amber -->
  <g>
    <animateMotion dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-0.8s">
      <mpath href="#jugglePath" />
    </animateMotion>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="-360" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      <use href="#bottleShape" fill="url(#amberBottle)" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottle 3: Blue -->
  <g>
    <animateMotion dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-1.6s">
      <mpath href="#jugglePath" />
    </animateMotion>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      <use href="#bottleShape" fill="url(#blueBottle)" />
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>

content.text:
Created `anteater-unicycle.svg` with a standalone SMIL-animated SVG featuring:

- **Unicycle**: Rotating spokes, pedals, and a subtle ground shadow pulse.
- **Anteater**: Giant anteater with its signature black-and-white shoulder stripe, long snout, swaying bushy tail, pedaling legs, gentle balancing bob, and tossing arms.
- **Juggling bottles**: Three spinning bottles (green, amber, and blue) following a staggered figure-8 juggling arc via `<animateMotion>`.
